caption: The drawing shows a single, centrally placed glass vessel with two handles and a wide, rounded bowl. The body of the vessel is colored with a transparent pink hue, while the handles, stem, and base are depicted in a clear, uncolored glass with gray shading to suggest transparency and reflection. The vessel sits on a short stem that broadens into a circular foot. The image is contained within a square border on a cream-colored background, and there is a small signature, "Capelli," in the lower left corner inside the border. The overall composition is simple, with the vessel being the only object and positioned against a plain backdrop.
title: Vase
